project.title: Klebsiella phage KpTDp1 isolated from sewage water
project.description: As we face global challenges such as antibiotic resistance and food security, harnessing the power of phages represents a promising avenue for innovation and sustainable solutions in various fields. In this context, this study aimed to isolate phage from waste water against a clinical strain klebsiella pneumiae and to study different characteristics of this phage.
project.center_name: University Tunis El Manar, Faculty of Science of Tunis, Biochemistry and Biotechnology Laboratory
